text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — planning the week’s release train handoff. Need owners for two lanes Thu 11:00 UTC and Thu 16:00 UTC. Who can take primary for the 11:00 slot?
Ben Ortiz: I can take 11:00 as primary. will do smoke and rollback on my lane.
Chao Li: I can take the 16:00 lane. blocking only if the storage migrations land late.
Dana S: quick question — are we keeping the canary for 11:00 at 5% or 10%?
Alex Kim: Keep 5% for the first pass. If metrics look stable after 10m, we bump to 20% then full.
Ben Ortiz: noted. who’s reviewing the PRs for the 11:00 bundle? I have two small fixes: #4821 and #4823.
Eric M: I’ll review #4821 by EOD. @Dana S can you glance #4823? small frontend tweak.
Dana S: on it, will review in the next hour.
Chao Li: FYI I’ll need a 15m prep window before 16:00 to warm KV caches. please avoid big traffic reroutes between 15:40-16:20.
Alex Kim: noted — add that to the runbook. Ben, paste your smoke checklist here so SRE knows what to watch.
Ben Ortiz: sure — smoke commands below:
```
# smoke steps
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.dev/health || exit 1
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/test/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .status
redis-cli -h kv-01.p -a $REDIS_PASS PING
# quick latency check after canary: curl -w '%{time_starttransfer}\n' -o /dev/null -s https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```
Ben Ortiz: rollback command is `./infra/rollbacks/rollback.sh --tag v1.9.3` (tested on staging).
deploy-bot: slot reserved: Thu 11:00 UTC (lane A) — owner: Ben Ortiz — canary: 5% — smoke owner: Ben Ortiz — rollback tag v1.9.3
Dana S: sweet — can we add a quick alert to PagerDuty if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m during canary?
Eric M: yes — I’ll add a temporary rule: canary-11-warning -> P1 if triggered.
Chao Li: for 16:00, my plan: warm caches + apply feature-flag rollout (FFY-213) at 5% then 100. If we see errors, flag -> off.
Alex Kim: perfect. one more: Ben, please add the PR numbers and the exact docker image tag to the handoff card. Chao, please confirm the migration PRs won’t land before your warm window.
Ben Ortiz: PRs are linked on the card: #4821, #4823. image: registry.redwood/dev/api:v1.9.3-20240315. added now.
Chao Li: confirmed — migration PR #4800 is scheduled for Friday, so safe for Thursday.
Dana S: review complete on #4823. approved. :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: good — backup owners? if Ben gets pulled, who does 11:00?
Eric M: I can cover as backup for Ben if needed. I know the rollback path.
Ben Ortiz: thanks. Eric, I’ll DM you the deploy notes and keys.
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: 2h before slot -> slack DM to owner. 15m before -> deploy channel ping.
Chao Li: small ask — can we extend the canary window to 20m if traffic low? more time helps cache warm.
Alex Kim: okay to extend to 20m based on low traffic signals. update runbook.
Ben Ortiz: final check: smoke owner has run the local rollback once?
Eric M: yes — ran rollback on staging and validated DB state repro.
Ben Ortiz: sweet. I’ll post a quick pre-deploy checklist 30m before.
Dana S: tagging the oncall for visibility: @Chao Li oncall, @Eric M for backup ops.
Alex Kim: thanks team. closing the loop: Thu 11:00 lane A — owner Ben; Thu 16:00 lane B — owner Chao; backups: Eric (A), Alex (B). smoke owners match lane owners. all PRs reviewed or in-review. see you in the slot. :raised_hands:
